why: The conjecture was proved by Dias da Silva and Hamidoune in 1994 (via representation theory/exterior algebra), with an alternative polynomial-method proof shortly after by Alon, Nathanson and Ruzsa; this predates the January 2024 snapshot, so the Wikipedia list entry appears stale. A 2026 arXiv paper gives a new elementary linear-algebraic proof of the same already-settled result, not new progress on an open question.
